Local assistance is available in Soundscaper and Framescaper. Models are stored in a directory you choose on your own filesystem, and every run happens on your device; nothing about your media is sent anywhere.

A workflow is a fixed graph of steps. A step that names an operation runs a model; a step that names none is deterministic and runs no model. An optional step is skipped when its model is not installed, and the workflow still produces a result from the steps that ran.

## Guided workflows

| Workflow | Workflow ID | Steps | Operations in order | Optional operations |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Clean up filler words and silence | `clean-filler-silence` | 3 | Voice activity detection | Speech recognition |
| Detect beats and tempo | `detect-beats-tempo` | 2 | Beat tracking | — |
| Enhance dialogue | `enhance-dialogue` | 1 | Speech enhancement | — |
| Generate editorial text | `generate-editorial-text` | 1 | Editorial generation | — |
| Identify speakers | `identify-speakers` | 2 | Speaker diarization | — |
| Index the transcript | `index-transcript` | 3 | Text embedding | — |
| Index the video | `index-video` | 5 | Shot detection → Image and text embedding | Optical character recognition |
| Make highlights | `make-highlights` | 6 | Shot detection | Audio tagging; Editorial generation |
| Mark cuts | `mark-cuts` | 2 | Shot detection | — |
| Mark reactions | `mark-reactions` | 2 | Audio tagging | — |
| Reduce reverb | `reduce-reverb` | 1 | Dereverberation | — |
| Reframe | `reframe` | 4 | Subject detection → Saliency detection | — |
| Separate dialogue, music, and effects | `separate-dialogue-music-effects` | 1 | Source separation | — |
| Transcribe and caption | `transcribe-captions` | 4 | Voice activity detection → Speech recognition | Word alignment |

## Operations

Every operation can also be run on its own, without a surrounding workflow, under the advanced ID below.

| Operation | Operation ID | Run on its own as |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Audio tagging | `audio-tagging` | `advanced:audio-tagging` |
| Beat tracking | `beat-tracking` | `advanced:beat-tracking` |
| Dereverberation | `dereverberation` | `advanced:dereverberation` |
| Editorial generation | `editorial-generation` | `advanced:editorial-generation` |
| Image and text embedding | `image-text-embedding` | `advanced:image-text-embedding` |
| Optical character recognition | `optical-character-recognition` | `advanced:optical-character-recognition` |
| Saliency detection | `saliency-detection` | `advanced:saliency-detection` |
| Shot detection | `shot-detection` | `advanced:shot-detection` |
| Source separation | `source-separation` | `advanced:source-separation` |
| Speaker diarization | `speaker-diarization` | `advanced:speaker-diarization` |
| Speech enhancement | `speech-enhancement` | `advanced:speech-enhancement` |
| Speech recognition | `speech-recognition` | `advanced:speech-recognition` |
| Subject detection | `subject-detection` | `advanced:subject-detection` |
| Text embedding | `text-embedding` | `advanced:text-embedding` |
| Voice activity detection | `voice-activity-detection` | `advanced:voice-activity-detection` |
| Word alignment | `word-alignment` | `advanced:word-alignment` |

## Published models

Models are published from `https://assets.soundscaper.org/models/` and verified against a recorded SHA-256 digest before use. “Minimum memory” is the free memory a model needs to load; it is not a claim about how fast it will run. A task below is what one model does, which is not always spelled the same as the operation that uses it, and a single operation may draw on more than one model.

| Model | Task | Version | Distribution | Minimum memory | Platforms |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
